name: Otter.ai
description: Otter.ai lets agents search and read meeting transcripts and summaries in the user's Otter account. Access is read-only.

prompts.text: Summarize my last meeting and list the action items.
Find meetings this month where pricing was discussed.
Draft a follow-up email from yesterday's customer call.

apps.name: Otter.ai
apps.description: Meeting search and transcript reading, over Otter.ai's MCP server with browser sign-in.
